title: Roof PV
boundaryClipped: Touches the survey boundary; the outline may be incomplete.
undone: The latest action was undone; its audit history is retained.
transformed: Manual operation saved. The new polygons are pending review.
splitHint: Click a cutting line that crosses the selected polygon, then finish. New parts require confirmation.
zoomHint: Zoom to level 16 or closer to inspect PV outlines. At most 1,000 outlines are rendered per view.
subtitle: Image review workspace
mapHint: Select a polygon or a candidate. Wheel to zoom; drag to pan.
uncalibrated: Uncalibrated; not an accuracy or identity probability.
reviewerHint: Enter your name before saving a decision.
reasonHint: Required for rejected or uncertain decisions
drawingHint: Click at least 3 corners on the map, then finish. Checking an area records inspection, not absence of PV.
editingHint: Drag the vertex handles. Save explicitly to persist the changed shape.
exportHint: EPSG:3035 · Includes all candidates and a separate confirmed PV layer.
saveBeforeExport: Save or discard your pending edits before creating an export.
noRuns: No completed runs. Run the Python sample pipeline, then reload.
saved: Decision saved to the review database.
added: Polygon saved. Manually added PV still requires confirmation.
limitsText: PV image review only. No MaStR matching, power estimation, or battery allocation. Detection does not prove roof mounting. This sample does not measure municipal accuracy.
attribution: Imagery: GeoBasis-DE/LGB, dl-de/by-2-0. OSM: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
missingReason: Enter a reason for this decision.
select: Select a candidate to inspect its evidence.
refreshHint: If a version conflict is reported, reload to inspect the latest decision before retrying.
